headline: Ensign Energy Deploys Third Drilling Rig to Venezuela from Permian
summary: Canadian drilling contractor Ensign Energy moved a third high-specification rig from the US Permian basin to Venezuela and plans to expand its operational fleet in the country, CEO Bob Geddes said.
why: Oilfield services deployments in Venezuela are closely watched as international operators respond to shifting sanctions and crude export demands.

impacts.name: Ensign Energy Services
impacts.why: Expanding active drilling rigs in Venezuela increases contract revenue and rig utilisation.
